description: An AI-driven customer support and helpdesk platform for managing customer conversations, inboxes, and knowledge bases.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 authorization code flow for public integrations and custom apps, and access tokens for private apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial to access developer tools and APIs, but ongoing API usage generally requires a paid plan.
api_notes: Covers Mailbox/Inbox API, Chat API, Docs API, Apps, and Webhooks for full CRUD access to support tickets and knowledge bases.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Help Scout; only community or third-party implementations may exist.
rationale: The API is robust and publicly documented with OAuth2, but full access requires moving past a trial or into a paid Help Scout plan.

evidence.note: Help Scout Developer portal overview detailing Inbox API, Chat API, Docs API, and Webhooks.
